"""Main: commit closed official full32K and new integration admission evidence."""
import fcntl
import hashlib
import importlib.util
import json
from pathlib import Path
import time

B = Path('/home/yayoi/.local/state/strata-sycl/post-reboot-tuning-20261007')
D = Path('/home/yayoi/ghq/github.com/yqYo1/Strata/.worktree/docs-sycl-storage-retention-20261009')
W = D.parent / 'sync-xe-v0143-nonfinite-20261012'
F = D / 'bench/results/2026-10-12-latest-updates-pristine-builds-host-regression'
L = Path('/home/yayoi/ghq/github.com/MistVVK/XeStrata/.worktree/fix-xestrata-e32-host-handoff-20261011/.lint')
O = B / 'xe-llvm-v711-source-v5/direct_owner.py'
assert hashlib.sha256(O.read_bytes()).hexdigest() == 'a29d8257eecc77c4ad9ae6671d092b56f4c09a35c4247c125fed3a8c8bc1f95f'
spec = importlib.util.spec_from_file_location('official_long_boundary_owner', O)
m = importlib.util.module_from_spec(spec)
spec.loader.exec_module(m)
ENV = dict(PATH=str(L/'bin')+':/usr/bin:/bin', HOME='/home/yayoi', LANG='C.UTF-8', LC_ALL='C.UTF-8')

def identity(p):
    return dict(path=str(p), sha256=m.sha(p), bytes=p.stat().st_size)

def compact(value):
    if isinstance(value, dict):
        result = {}
        for key, item in value.items():
            if key == 'token_logprob_sha256':
                result['token_logprob_identity'] = {'sha256':item}
            elif key in ('evidence','command_evidence'):
                result[key] = {label:{channel:dict(bytes=len(text.encode()), sha256=hashlib.sha256(text.encode()).hexdigest(),
                    content=text if len(text.encode()) <= 16384 else text[:8192]+'\n[compact middle omitted]\n'+text[-4096:])
                    for channel,text in fields.items()} for label,fields in item.items()}
            else:
                result[key] = compact(item)
        return result
    if isinstance(value, list):
        return [compact(v) for v in value]
    if isinstance(value, str) and len(value.encode()) > 32768:
        return dict(bytes=len(value.encode()), sha256=hashlib.sha256(value.encode()).hexdigest(),
                    head=value[:8192], tail=value[-4096:], scope='Compact derivative; exact original remains pinned for current admission consumer')
    return value

NAMES = ['latest-update-main-controller-cpu-root-v8', 'latest-update-main-controller-cpu-root-v9',
    'latest-update-main-controller-cpu-root-v10', 'latest-update-main-controller-cpu-root-v11',
    'latest-update-main-admission-prepare-root-v5', 'latest-update-main-provider-health-official-startup-root-v6',
    'latest-update-main-provider-health-official-model-root-v2',
    'latest-update-pristine-official-long-model-root-v1/official-startup',
    'latest-update-pristine-official-long-model-root-v1/official-model',
    'latest-update-main-integrated-build-reuse-root-v1', 'latest-update-main-integrated-build-reuse-root-v2',
    'latest-update-main-heldout-provenance-root-v1', 'latest-update-main-integrated-admission-root-v2',
    'latest-update-main-integrated-provider-health-xe-startup-root-v1',
    'latest-update-integrated-neutral-model-root-v5/xe-startup']

with (B/'owned-v0141-measurement.lock').open('a') as lock:
    fcntl.flock(lock, fcntl.LOCK_EX | fcntl.LOCK_NB)
    out = B/'latest-update-main-official-long-boundary-root-v1'
    assert not out.exists()
    out.mkdir()
    r = dict(active=True, passed=False, complete=False, commands=[], controller=identity(Path(__file__)),
             gpu_executed=False, raw_logs_deleted=False, artifacts=[], whole_wall_seconds=600)
    def save():
        (out/'record.json').write_text(json.dumps(r,indent=2)+'\n')
    owner = m.Owner(out/'commands',save)
    r['commands'] = owner.commands
    start = time.monotonic()
    def run(label,argv,cwd=D):
        remaining = 600-(time.monotonic()-start)
        assert remaining>0
        c,so,se = owner.run(label,argv,ENV,cwd,wall=min(120,remaining),cpu=480,
            rss_cap=8<<30,text_cap=64<<20,file_cap=64<<20,total_cap=96<<20)
        r.setdefault('evidence',{})[label] = dict(stdout=so.read_text(),stderr=se.read_text())
        save()
        assert m.closed(c) and c['session_anchored'] and c['exit_code']==0, label
        return so.read_text().strip()
    staged = out/'staged-artifacts'
    staged.mkdir()
    prepared = []
    def write(relative,value):
        target = staged/relative
        target.parent.mkdir(parents=True,exist_ok=True)
        text = json.dumps(value,ensure_ascii=False,indent=2)+'\n'
        assert len(text.encode())<1<<20
        target.write_text(text)
        prepared.append((target,F/relative))
    try:
        assert not run('initial-status',['/usr/bin/git','status','--porcelain','--untracked-files=all'])
        assert run('branch',['/usr/bin/git','branch','--show-current'])=='docs/sycl-storage-retention-2026-10-09'
        assert run('origin',['/usr/bin/git','remote','get-url','origin'])=='git@github.com:yqYo1/Strata.git'
        assert all(line.startswith('file:/home/yayoi/.config/git/config') for line in run('identity',
            ['/usr/bin/git','config','--show-origin','--get-regexp',r'^user\.(name|email)$']).splitlines())
        records = {}
        for name in NAMES:
            p = B/name/'record.json'
            v = json.loads(p.read_text())
            assert not v['active']
            assert all(c['direct_child_reaped'] and c['session_empty'] and c['session_anchored'] and
                c['ownership_status']=='observed' and not c['cleanup'] and not c['survivors']
                for c in v.get('commands',[])+v.get('guard_commands',[]))
            records[name] = v
            write('receipts/'+name.replace('/','--')+'.json',dict(original=identity(p),derivative=True,
                original_status_preserved=True, original_passed=v['passed'],receipt=compact(v)))
        research = []
        for n in range(228,236):
            found = list((B/'research-20261009').glob('*round'+str(n)+'-v1.txt'))
            assert len(found)==1
            research.append(found[0])
        research += [B/'research-20261009'/name for name in ['implementation-latest-update-integrated-neutral-controller-source-v2.txt',
            'implementation-latest-update-integrated-neutral-controller-source-v3.txt',
            'implementation-pristine-official-cache512-controller-source-v1.txt']]
        report_entries = []
        for p in research:
            relative = 'research/'+p.name
            target = staged/relative
            target.parent.mkdir(parents=True,exist_ok=True)
            raw = p.read_text()
            target.write_text(raw.rstrip('\n')+'\n')
            prepared.append((target,F/relative))
            report_entries.append(dict(original=identity(p),archive=str((F/relative).relative_to(D)),
                archive_identity=identity(target),normalization='Only repeated EOF newline normalized; original unchanged',
                model='gpt-6.1-sol' if p.name.startswith('implementation') else 'gpt-6-luna',
                main_full_report_review=True,status='completed',measured=False))
        prior = F/'report-registry-v155.json'
        previous = json.loads(prior.read_text())
        assert previous['research_completed']==725
        write('report-registry-v156.json',dict(research_completed=725+len(report_entries),
            prior_registry_path=str(prior.relative_to(D)),prior_registry_sha256=m.sha(prior),new_reports=report_entries,
            main_sole_execution_owner=True,scope='Recurring distinct read-only scopes, report history shared, no intervention before FINAL; implementation source-only and Main-managed testing'))
        source_names = ['latest-update-main-controller-cpu-v8.py','latest-update-main-controller-cpu-v9.py',
            'latest-update-main-controller-cpu-v10.py','latest-update-main-controller-cpu-v11.py',
            'latest-update-main-admission-prepare-v5.py','latest-update-pristine-admission-resolver-main-v6.py',
            'latest-update-main-integrated-build-reuse-v1.py','latest-update-main-integrated-build-reuse-v2.py',
            'latest-update-main-heldout-provenance-v1.py','latest-update-main-integrated-admission-v2.py',
            'latest-update-main-integrated-provider-health-v1.py']
        sources = [B/name for name in source_names]+[Path(__file__)]
        for folder in ['latest-update-pristine-official-long-controller-source-v1',
            'latest-update-integrated-neutral-controller-source-v5','latest-update-pristine-official-cache512-controller-source-v1']:
            sources += [p for p in sorted((B/folder).iterdir()) if p.is_file() and p.suffix in ('.py','.cpp','.txt','.json','.patch')]
        write('controller-source-v156.json',dict(scope='Reproducible sources and exact schema; cache512 remains source-only, not runtime qualification',
            files=[dict(identity=identity(p),content=p.read_text()) for p in sources]))
        official = records['latest-update-pristine-official-long-model-root-v1/official-model']
        assert official['passed'] and official['validation']['prompt_tokens']==32768 and official['validation']['generated_tokens']==16
        sample = dict(original=identity(B/'latest-update-pristine-official-long-model-root-v1/official-model/record.json'),
            phase='single diagnostic, validation and tracing enabled',performance_eligible=False,
            argv=official['argv'],environment=official['environment'],effective_info=official['effective_info'],
            validation=compact(official['validation']),host_wall=official['host_wall_samples'],
            diagnostic_prefill_tps=32768000/official['validation']['engine_prefill_ms'],
            diagnostic_decode_tps=16000/official['validation']['engine_decode_ms'],
            normal_quit=official['model_close'],fault_gate_passed=official['kernel_gate_passed'])
        remote = {engine:run('remote-'+engine,['/usr/bin/git','ls-remote',url,'HEAD','refs/heads/main','refs/heads/master'])
            for engine,url in [('official','https://github.com/Niko1221/Strata.git'),('xe','https://github.com/MistVVK/XeStrata.git')]}
        write('pristine-official-full32k-results-v156.json',dict(official_revision='7695859aa13afb248bdb4d36f9b2e95707db079d',
            official_version='v0.1.43',xe_revision='da3d426079019daa6e01388d03b0d94ae67070b7',xe_version='xe0.1.42',
            current_remote_heads=remote,remote_verified_utc=m.utc(),pristine_source_patch_applied=False,sample=sample,
            integrated_source_revision='0691bcdf5af63a85b3b25650f367d3276db64035',
            integrated_small_gpu_fixtures_passed=True,integrated_startup_passed=True,integrated_actual32k_pairs_pending=True,
            official_parameter_optimization_complete=False,full262144_runtime_qualified=False,
            corrections={'CPU_fixture':'Nested STOP mock requested80 CPU seconds above inherited61 hard limit. Main fixture-only cap30 passes; model affinity CPU unchanged. Failed CPU roots9/10 retained, no GPU/model launched there.',
                'Ninja_reuse':'First reuse proof compared all Ninja targets against historical selected targets. New proof uses exact historical argv, compiler/dependency/source/recipe identities and current changed Python tests; historical build not relabeled.',
                'R235_scope':'Reviewer was additionally scoped to not read original v4 build receipt. This is not a Main prohibition; only prefill-gemm-only-contract-root-v1 is credential-tainted and forbidden. Main readonly v4 reconciliation preserves original status.',
                'Heldout':'Complete37462-ID source-review prompt retained, one common-prefix ID and45 shared16-ID shingles with canonical32K. Narrow different-input numerical A/B only, no authorship/population/quality independence claim.'},
            next=['Actual integration debug and three clean32K guard pairs plus full37462 heldout pair',
                'Official capacity property gate then unpatched512/per-layer and auto tuning; phase-independent decisions',
                'Actual full262144-cell boundary remains required']))
        write('retention-v156.json',dict(raw_logs_deleted=False,no_active_run_cleanup=True,
            current_consumer='Exact hash admission receipts and source packets for current integration and official capacity campaigns',
            byte_budget=128<<20,source_byte_budget=8<<20,owner='/root',
            next_review='After current campaigns close, compact and retire successful duplicate API/journal/build/health traces with path/hash/reason manifest',
            logs_do_not_represent_final_optimization=True))
        leak = out/'secret-scan.json'
        run('private-secret-scan',[str(L/'bin/gitleaks'),'dir',str(staged),'--no-banner','--redact','--report-format','json','--report-path',str(leak)])
        assert json.loads(leak.read_text())==[]
        run('report-lints',['/bin/bash',str(W/'tools/lint/run.sh'),*[str(p) for p,_ in prepared if p.suffix=='.json']],cwd=W)
        for p,target in prepared:
            assert not target.exists()
            target.parent.mkdir(parents=True,exist_ok=True)
            target.write_bytes(p.read_bytes())
            r['artifacts'].append(identity(target))
        run('whole-secret-scan',[str(L/'bin/gitleaks'),'dir',str(F),'--no-banner','--redact'])
        new = [str(target.relative_to(D)) for _,target in prepared]
        run('stage',['/usr/bin/git','add','--',*new])
        run('check',['/usr/bin/git','diff','--cached','--check'])
        run('commit',['/usr/bin/git','commit','-m','docs(sycl): record full pristine official32K and integration admission'])
        r['revision'] = run('head',['/usr/bin/git','rev-parse','HEAD'])
        run('push',['/usr/bin/git','push','origin','HEAD'])
        assert not run('final-status',['/usr/bin/git','status','--porcelain'])
        r['complete'] = True
    except BaseException as error:
        r['error'] = repr(error)
    finally:
        r.update(active=owner.active is not None,finished_utc=m.utc())
        r['passed'] = bool(r['complete'] and not r['active'] and not r.get('error'))
        save()
    print(json.dumps({k:r.get(k) for k in ('passed','error','revision')}))
    raise SystemExit(0 if r['passed'] else 1)
